questions.name: is_category
questions.instructions: Is the item on this receipt line itself personal electronics? Yes: The item is personal electronics: consumer devices (headphones, earbuds, tablets, e-readers, smart watches, fitness trackers, cameras, drones, speakers, games consoles, televisions, item trackers) and accessories made for them, such as cases, straps and chargers. No: The item is not personal electronics. Decide what the item IS, not what words its name contains. The merchant and the declared expense type are context only and never override the item itself.
